review.posthog_relevance: Protects bounded-window incremental ingestion paths in warehouse connectors from redundant or unbounded scans when the pipeline is not incremental, preventing potential resource exhaustion or performance degradation.
review.reason: Adds a guard check to distinguish incremental pipelines from full-refresh runs before executing incremental-field-dependent ingestion, preventing redundant scans and unbounded resource consumption.
review.uncertainty: The exact warehouse connector implementation and the specific performance impact of the unguarded path are not demonstrated in the provided hunk; the benefit relies on the correctness of the `pipeline_is_incremental` and `table.requires_filter` flags and the behavior of the downstream ingestion, which are not shown.
